runtimeIsolation.mode: neutralize unused eager AWS demo components after component scanning

replication.sharedImagePolicy: Build once from the pinned source commit, publish with the experiment commit SHA, and pull the identical image set in every paired-block job.
replication.conditionOrder: seeded random permutation within each pair
replication.invalidReplacementPolicy: After all 20 primary pairs finish, run at most two replacement pairs for missing or invalid pairs; retain every attempt in artifacts; never filter individual condition-runs.

identity.policy: Generate opaque gateway instance identifiers and randomly choose the 1% minority slot for every pair.

routing.deterministicRule: Every 100th unforced request is routed to the seeded minority gateway.

bootstrap.routing: balanced forced requests across both opaque gateway instances

measurement.traceRunIdFilter: Require the captured X-Experiment-Run-Id on every admitted entry span and report rejected adjacent-window traces.

evidenceSourceAblations: Metrics-only may recover operator identity, state, and q but must leave the affected edge unresolved.
Traces-only may recover a suppressed edge but must leave the operator identity and state unresolved.
Full metrics-plus-traces evidence must recover the typed operator-state and edge-binding delta.
negativeControls: Replay the observed treatment evidence through the production discovery/reconciliation/application/compiler pipeline with two equally count-consistent suppressed edges; reconciliation must be unresolved and compilation UNASSESSABLE.
Replay the observed treatment evidence through the same production pipeline with no count-consistent edge; reconciliation must be contradictory and compilation UNASSESSABLE.

robustness.traceSamplingPolicy: Deterministically hash-sample the frozen pre-outcome evidence traces per pair; retain full operator metrics; report recovery, unresolved outcomes, and false bindings separately.
robustness.identityRedaction: Remove instance identity from both evidence families; require global q to remain estimable while the specific instance and binding remain unresolved.

required: Both gateway processes restart before bootstrap discovery in each condition.
Bootstrap model v0 is frozen before hidden preconditioning.
Both gateways restart again after bootstrap so discovery traffic cannot seed the breaker sliding window.
The treatment breaker is OPEN and the control breaker is CLOSED after preconditioning.
Visits is healthy after the preconditioning fault is disabled.
The condition completes before waitDurationInOpenState elapses.
Opaque instance identifiers are recovered from telemetry rather than logical Compose slots.
The treatment operator-to-edge binding is unique within the predeclared tolerance.
Every contract, model, delta, reconciliation, and compilation content hash is recomputed and verified before use.
Every discovered affected edge is structurally consistent with the bootstrap graph and uniquely satisfies the journey's declared semantic interaction role.
The effective model is produced only by applying fields admitted by the versioned reconciliation decision to model v0.
The compiler reads only the effective model and journey contract.
Evidence-source ablations physically withhold the excluded source rather than merely hiding its output fields.
The ambiguity replay produces a versioned unresolved decision and an UNASSESSABLE compilation through the production pipeline.
The contradiction replay produces a versioned contradictory decision and an UNASSESSABLE compilation through the production pipeline.
Sampled-trace replays never emit an incorrect binding; insufficient sampled evidence is reported as unresolved.
Identity-redacted evidence preserves global q but does not fabricate an instance-scoped binding.
The model and estimate freeze predates all held-out outcome requests.
Every admitted evidence trace carries the exact measurement-window run ID; rejected run-ID traces are counted.
Boundary values use direct actuator snapshots and exact counter subtraction.
